description: Creative Cloud Libraries: place a library asset in the document (linked to the library when its data says so, so library edits update the layout), export the selection as the files a library asset needs, with a thumbnail size, or choose whether new swatches, paragraph styles and character styles are added to the current library automatically (CC Libraries panel: Place Linked; Add Content; Add to CC Libraries in the New Swatch and New Style dialogs)

action.description: What to do; auto_add sets and returns the automatic adding options

assetData.description: For place: the asset description JSON from Creative Cloud Libraries (as the CC Libraries panel passes to InDesign)

characterStyles.description: For auto_add: add new character styles to the current CC Library

paragraphStyles.description: For auto_add: add new paragraph styles to the current CC Library

path.description: For export_selection: the file to export the selection to

swatches.description: For auto_add: add new swatches to the current CC Library

thumbnailHeight.description: For export_selection: maximum thumbnail height in pixels

thumbnailWidth.description: For export_selection: maximum thumbnail width in pixels

name: manage_cc_library_assets
title: Manage Cc Library Assets
